entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: H-Hey, where are you going!?[n]We should be meeting Kaneshiro!
entries.uk: Г-гей, куди ти!?[n]Нам треба зустрітися з Канесіро!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's get over to reception[n]before we go off explorin'.
entries.uk: Ну ж бо, спершу до рецепції, а вже[n]потім досліджувати.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We ain't gonna be able to get[n]through like this. Let's try and[n]find a different way in.
entries.uk: Так ми не пройдемо. Пошукаймо[n]інший вхід.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nope, no way this'll work...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Think it's time to pop out that[n]keycard from earlier?
entries.uk: Може, час дістати ту ключ-картку,[n]що ми знайшли?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hold up! Think we can use that[n]keycard to open the door?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's try it!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, we won't be able to use it if it's[n]being controlled somewhere else...
entries.uk: Хм, нею не скористатися, якщо[n]керування — деінде...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is that... an elevator?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, it has to be the one they're[n]controlling externally. So this is[n]right above it...
entries.uk: Так, мабуть, це той, яким керують[n]ззовні. Отже, ми просто[n]над ним...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So what, this is the control room[n]or something? What's the point of[n]comin' here?
entries.uk: І що, це типу пункт керування?[n]Навіщо було сюди йти?

entries.en: We can get on the elevator.
We can go to the basement.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Perceptive as usual, Joker.[n]We should be able to ride[n]on top of the elevator.
entries.uk: Проникливий, як завжди, Джокере.[n]Ми можемо проїхатися[n]на даху ліфта.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see. We sneak atop it, then[n]wait for it to move on its own.
entries.uk: Зрозуміло. Пробираємося на нього[n]і чекаємо, поки він рушить сам.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It does sound like that plan will[n]take us further down.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, let's get on there!

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Reception is just past this door.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Hey, not that way! It's just past this door.[n]Hurry on in.
entries.uk: Гей, не туди! Вона одразу за цими дверима.[n]Заходьте швидше.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Reception is just to the right.[n]Don't go anywhere else.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: That's not the way! Hurry up and[n]get moving to the right!

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: This is the reception office.[n]Hurry on inside.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: That's not the way. Just get in towards[n]the back!

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Hey, that's not the right way! It's just[n]past this door, so hurry on inside!
entries.uk: Гей, не туди! Вона одразу за цими[n]дверима, тож заходьте швидше!

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Reception is to the right, towards[n]the back.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: Reception is to the right. Hurry up.

entries.speaker: Security Guard
entries.en: This is reception. Hurry inside.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, we don't got time to be[n]headin' back right now!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's go for the exit! Hurry!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Run, Joker! The exit's close!
